name: Product Image Editor with Canva for WooCommerce
author: IT Path Solutions

sections.description:
Connect WooCommerce to Canva seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with Canva, enabling effortless product image creation and updates.

Once connected via a secure Authorization Code, Canva can fetch your WooCommerce product data. You can then design or update product images using Canva’s powerful tools. When you’re done, export the image (PNG or JPG), and it will be automatically added to the product gallery in your WooCommerce store.

This plugin streamlines your product image workflow — from design to upload — all within minutes.

Key Features:

  • Generates a secure authorization code and website URL for connection
  • Allows Canva to fetch WooCommerce product data
  • Enables image editing directly in Canva
  • Automatically updates WooCommerce product gallery with new images
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/product-image-editor-with-canva-for-woocommerce or install it via WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Setting → Canva Connect from the admin sidebar.
  4. Copy the Authorization Code and Website URL into your Canva application.
  5. Your Canva app will now be able to list products and push new images to your WooCommerce gallery.
sections.faq:
How does Canva know which store to connect to?

Using the secure token and website URL provided by this plugin.

Where are the new images saved?

All new images edited in Canva are saved to the WooCommerce product gallery.

Does it overwrite existing images?

No. The new image is added to the product’s gallery as a new image.

Is the integration secure?

Yes. Only with the correct authorization token and domain can the Canva app access your store data.
